item.title: If Sexy Isn’t the Goal Anymore, Why Does Red Lipstick Still Look Good at 60?
item.description: When did you stop wearing red lipstick? Was it gradual? One day it just felt like “too much”? Did someone make a comment – well-meaning or otherwise – that lodged itself quietly in your mind? Or did life simply get busy, practical, serious… and red felt frivolous?

item.title: The Joy of Eating Early (and Getting Home Before Dark)
item.description: I remember the first time I floated a 5 pm dinner to friends. I expected my invite text would prompt an urgent “Is everything okay?” phone call. Or a sarcastic, “Are we so old we need the early bird special?” Instead, my phone buzzed back almost immediately: “We’d LOVE it!” – capital letters and all...

item.title: Along the Arc of Life: What Time Reveals About the Words We Once Wrote
item.description: There are moments when old letters or early writings resurface – sometimes by accident, sometimes deliberately. When that happens, what stands out isn’t the words themselves, but the feelings that rise while reading them. Not the feelings we have now, but the ones that once compelled us to write at all...

item.title: How to Find an Honest Real Estate Agent (Whether Buying or Selling)
item.description: Let's face it. Real estate agents get a bad rap. But there are some very good ones out there helping buyers and sellers every day, and doing a great job at it. It's like any other profession. You have to find them. So how do you find an honest real estate agent to buy or sell your home? Good question!
